data_output.description: data.py remains unchanged and encode(splits) returns encoded split tuples (features, labels, user_ids), where features are int32 matrices with exact field order [user_id, video_id, author_id, tab, dur_bucket, hour, weekday], labels are float32 long_view values, and user_ids preserve canonical source row order. Training uses only rows dated 20220408..20220421 inclusive; validation uses the configured split. No ground truth is written to the prediction artifact.

model_input.description: Normal training supplies two equal-shaped int32 feature matrices, positive_features and negative_features, each containing encoded rows from the same user and the same seven fields [user_id, video_id, author_id, tab, dur_bucket, hour, weekday]. The pairwise method returns mean softplus(-(logit_positive-logit_negative)) with L2 regularization and updates the existing FM parameters via Adam. Prediction accepts one encoded feature matrix and returns a one-dimensional score array in input order.
